title: Faceted Flight aircraft variants
description: One aircraft's variants, as data (docs/plan/AIRCRAFT-VARIANTS.md section 2, DEV-380). Every number under a variant's scale is a dimensionless MULTIPLIER on the generated constants sheet's value at that key: the sheet stays 2016's, sim/variant.ts applies the factors at the vehicle's construction seam, and standard is 2016 by construction because its scale is empty. File order is slot order in the hangar. Anniversary only: an edition's gameplay.variants.enabled decides whether the step exists, and Classic always flies standard. THIS SCHEMA IS A GATE: additionalProperties is false at every level. The rules it cannot express (exactly one standard, standard scales nothing, no duplicate ids, a bleed kept below 1, every key a finite number on the real sheet) are validateAircraft's, run at load.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes: it is a storage-key and URL segment (ff2.best.<mission>.<mode>.<variant>.v1, ?variant=).

factor.description: A multiplier. 1 is 2016; it may not be zero or negative.

listed.description: false: NOT READY TO SHIP. The hangar does not offer it, and a remembered choice of it flies standard. ?variant=<id> still flies it: a development switch, as ?mission= is for an unlisted course. Absent is listed, and standard is always listed.

hoverjetScale.description: Sheet key -> MULTIPLIER on the generated sheet value at that key. Exactly src/content/aircraft-schema.ts VARIANT_SCALE_KEYS.hoverjet (tests/unit/aircraft-content.test.ts holds the two lists equal). A per-tick bleed scaled to 1 or above, and a key that is not a finite number on the real sheet, are refused at load by validateAircraft.

hoverjetMechanics.description: Absolute numbers for a mechanic 2016 never had, so there is nothing on the sheet to scale. None is implemented for the hoverjet yet: DEV-383 adds the JumpSeat's jump and DEV-384 its gravityScale, each with its own schema here. VARIANT_MECHANICS in src/content/aircraft-schema.ts is the runtime list.

listed.description: false: NOT READY TO SHIP. The hangar does not offer it, and a remembered choice of it flies standard. ?variant=<id> still flies it: a development switch, as ?mission= is for an unlisted course. Absent is listed, and standard is always listed.

jumpseatScale.description: Sheet key -> MULTIPLIER on the generated sheet value at that key. Exactly src/content/aircraft-schema.ts VARIANT_SCALE_KEYS.jumpseat (tests/unit/aircraft-content.test.ts holds the two lists equal). A per-tick bleed scaled to 1 or above, and a key that is not a finite number on the real sheet, are refused at load by validateAircraft.

jumpseatMechanics.description: Numbers for a mechanic 2016 never had, so there is nothing on the sheet to scale: DEV-384's gravityScale and DEV-383's jump. VARIANT_MECHANICS in src/content/aircraft-schema.ts is the runtime list.

gravityScale.description: DEV-384. A MULTIPLIER on the world's gravity for this seat alone (sim/jumpseat.ts JumpSeatMechanics); the world stays (0, -32, 0). Scale hoverMotor.hoverForce by the same factor or the cushion sinks: tests/unit/variant-overclocked.test.ts holds every variant carrying one at 2016's hover equilibrium.

jumpseatJump.description: DEV-383, the jumping spider (sim/jumpseat-jump.ts JumpSpec). Hold both triggers on a surface to charge; release to launch along the seat's own up. ABSOLUTE numbers, Anniversary design with nothing on 2016's sheet to scale. validateJump in src/content/aircraft-schema.ts also refuses a minChargeSeconds longer than chargeSeconds, an impulseMax below impulseMin, and curve keys that do not rise strictly through [0, 1].

chargeSeconds.description: Seconds of charging from empty to full. The tank pays the seat's boosted rate while it fills, and nothing once it is full.

minChargeSeconds.description: A release after less charging than this does nothing, so brushing both triggers does not hop.

impulseMin.description: m/s along the seat's own +Y at the lightest release that fires.

impulseMax.description: m/s along the seat's own +Y at a full charge.

curve.description: Charge 0..1 -> how far from impulseMin to impulseMax, 0..1. A Unity-shaped AnimationCurve, evaluated by sim/art-lean.ts evaluateCurve.

burstSeconds.description: Seconds the dv is spread over from the release: round(burstSeconds / dt) fixed ticks of dv / n each.

graceSeconds.description: Seconds a seat may go unsupported and still count as standing (coyote time), so a seat whose feet chatter on a crest or rock after a landing can still charge.

gliderFile.description: DEV-399 (AIRCRAFT-VARIANTS section 5, G1). The glider has no generated sheet - 2016 shipped it switched off, so there is nothing to extract (DEV-145) - and so it is the one aircraft whose file carries absolute numbers, in `tuning`. Its variants arrive at G5 as design targets re-solved into a tuning, never as scales: the fields are solved from three chosen numbers, and scaling one moves the others' meaning (section 3.3).

gliderTuning.description: Every field sim/glider.ts's GliderTuning reads, as an absolute number, and no other: exactly src/content/aircraft-schema.ts GLIDER_TUNING_KEYS (tests/unit/glider-wire.test.ts holds the three lists equal, with PROTOTYPE_GLIDER's keys). Anniversary design, chosen and solved in DEV-145.

gliderScale.description: Empty, and it stays empty: exactly src/content/aircraft-schema.ts VARIANT_SCALE_KEYS.glider. The glider's fields are solved, so its variants are design targets (G5), not multipliers.

gliderMechanics.description: None implemented. VARIANT_MECHANICS in src/content/aircraft-schema.ts is the runtime list.
